macro_cross_check.verdict: PASS, near-exact: protein -0.1% and calories +0.1% against the source's published label - the strongest confirmation available that the rotisserie whole-bird cooked-meat basis and every portion are right. Fat -6.5% tracks. Carbs +37% relative (14.3 vs 10.4 g) comes from booking the full 47 oz of canned chiles at the DB row's as-packed carb density plus USDA veg values; the source card printed total carbs equal to net carbs (extractor flagged it), so its 10.4 is likely net - our total-carb figure is the conservative one and clears the gate with 20 g to spare.
macro_cross_check.band_check: computed 543.8 cal in [400, 650] PASS (144 above the floor, 106 below the ceiling); carbs 14.3 g <= 35 PASS.

board_defects_observed: bell-peppers commodity mixes color classes (green cells at 5 stores + a Family Fare yellow at ~2x the green price); the yellow line here is board-sanctioned but will be priced at the green-cell cheapest, understating cost. A yellow-bell split (or folding premium colors into red-bell-pepper's class) belongs at the match-soundness gate.
